description: Application for non-material amendment to allow the addition of mechanical plant extract to the north-west (rear) elevation, following planning permission 00885/C/S3 dated 17/3/2015 for Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to allow a smaller footprint of the new buildings of planning permission 00885/C/S2 dated 29/05/2014 for the demolition and removal of the existing cafe and public toilets and the formation of a new cafe and carriage display building, including public toilets
